subject: CYCLE-2 HANDOFF: fail-safe host lifecycle gate 9/9 PASS; manual-only lifecycle until native adapter exists
body: Two-cycle bounded Artifactory NG host-lifecycle study complete. A reference lifecycle gate passed 9/9 adversarial tests: required-write failure blocks archive; Primary lease must be released/superseded before old-Primary archive eligibility; UI-only pin/archive yields MANUAL_ACTION_REQUIRED; request never equals verified completion; only observed host completion can be VERIFIED/terminal; absent exact pre-prompt injection falls back to POST_START_DISCOVERY_BOOTSTRAP; snapshot restore without an identity API cannot claim CHAT_IDENTITY_RESTORED. Recommendation: successor host adapter splits host_feature_state from agent_invocation_state and preserves action verification separately. This is READY_FOR_MANAGER_REVIEW only, not production acceptance. New Primary P0 inner-display wake/first-open-crash directive arrived during finalization; this lane is now COMPLETE and releases attention to that higher-priority R&D work.
